results_should_use_scientific_narrative_.statement: results should use scientific narrative not report style

figures_require_standalone_and_word_rend.statement: figures require standalone and word render qa

avoid_formulaic_contrast_templates.statement: Revise every confirmed rhetorical contrast while retaining concrete engineering conditions.

avoid_mechanical_transition_scaffolding.statement: Do not organize scientific logic with repeated generic transitions.

avoid_mechanical_enumeration.statement: Use enumeration only when it carries real structure, such as distinct contributions.

avoid_defensive_writing.statement: Remove every confirmed self-negating or reviewer-facing defense, including a single occurrence; correct unsupported claims at source and state genuine operating conditions and adverse observations directly.

evidence_boundaries_without_defensive_di.statement: State scientific and engineering conditions and adverse observations accurately; keep operational status and self-negating defenses outside final text. Conclusions synthesize supported outcomes without a mandatory catalogue of missing capabilities.

citations_follow_semantic_referent.statement: Attach citations to the author, named method/object, or exact supported claim.

methodology_is_mathematical_chain.statement: Write methodology as a continuous mathematical dependency rather than a module list.

equation_backend_supports_office_math_an.statement: Support declared Office Math or MathType Toggle TeX without silent conversion or mixing.

results_follow_scientific_questions.statement: Organize results around scientific questions rather than artifact order.

distinct_subfigures_receive_distinct_int.statement: Interpret distinct subfigures separately or through an explicit joint synthesis.

table_and_figure_roles_are_not_redundant.statement: Assign nonredundant evidence roles to tables and figures.

project_lineage_language_stays_out_of_ma.statement: Keep project and prompt lineage out of scientific prose without flagging neutral phrases such as previous studies.

tables_use_semantic_compression.statement: Retain table fields only when quantitative, discriminative, reproducibility-critical, or non-derivable.

office_math_covers_inline_math_semantics.statement: Office Math manuscripts require real OMML for display equations and genuine inline variables or expressions.

consumer_gated_verification.statement: Do not generate or require cryptographic hashes unless an explicit consumer, user request, transfer-integrity requirement, or release contract makes them operationally necessary.

scientific_figure_recipe_pool.statement: Use accepted scientific figures as reusable design evidence; choose structure from the question and data schema, then MATLAB or Python, without copying dataset-specific values or overfitting source aesthetics.

project_connected_client_report_prose.statement: Organize assigned subtopics around connected data/model/output reasoning and engineering questions; remove experimental, defensive and authoring narration while retaining adaptation, conditions and adverse results. Read neighboring paragraphs together and preserve accepted evidence during prose-only revisions.

project_regular_black_word_profile.statement: Default to regular black SimSun/TNR, 12 pt two-character-indented 1.5-multiple body and black unshaded three-line tables at 10.5 pt single spacing; explicit user/customer templates override. Keep headings regular and distinguish plot typography and paragraph roles.

project_mathtype_includes_inline_referen.statement: Native MathType includes genuine inline variables and table formulas, with ordered case-sensitive source coverage, context-appropriate final sizing, native-content verification and render/reopen checks; counts alone are insufficient.

project_centered_numbered_native_equatio.statement: Center actual native display objects in the current text area, with continuous right-margin numeric fields; inline math is unnumbered. Preserve native streams/previews and cross-reference targets; layout flags alone are not Word visual centering, authenticity or reopen proof.

project_question_led_diverse_figures.statement: Choose complementary plot families from technical outputs, not type quotas or all-heatmap/bar/line defaults; omit defensive footers, preserve aspect ratios and inspect insertion size. Verify Chinese bold YaHei and TNR glyph handling for categories, legends, mixed labels and secondary axes separately from Word fonts.

project_continuous_numerically_matched_a.statement: Carry model outputs into engineering analysis with named fair cases, correct units/statistics/time windows/denominators, supported mechanisms and actual uncertainty semantics. Aligned regional aggregation is not a sum of separate peaks; zero-display omission does not alter valid data or metric populations.

project_gb_first_use_verified_references.statement: Use GB/T 7714 sequential citation unless overridden; verify the applicable edition, publisher/repository metadata and first-use order. Distinguish dataset contributors/version from article metadata; do not cite local paths or infer publication years from DOI strings.

project_six_class_editorial_gate.statement: Conference, Journal and Project final text must contain no confirmed experimental-report, AI formulaic, stacked, redundant, defensive or mechanical prose. All branches use current-text-bound candidates, strict final checks and whole-text semantic reading. Preserve actual technical protocols, conditions and adverse observations; Project delivery screens the current DOCX.

native_diagrams_prioritize_real_mechanis.statement: Organize native diagrams around real mechanisms; align repeated visible centers/baselines, map every legend/callout, and check scaled strokes, head clearances, painted bounds and complete motifs. Preserve accepted constraints and truthful native editability.

accepted_figure_source_and_frozen_constr.statement: Use the user-designated saved source and accepted editing history; bind export/insertion to that revision. Preserve accepted text, icons, geometry and native equations; later timestamps on old exports or manifests do not override user edits.

decision_results_show_actual_domains_and.statement: Visualize verified preparation/domain/action results with explicit operating regimes, faithful threshold censoring and distinct branch/support semantics, without new experiments or invented statistical complexity.

word_figure_insertion_preserves_native_c.statement: Insert an aspect-preserving export from the accepted source into a manuscript copy, preserve existing native equations/media, update figure references collision-safely, clear effective picture indents and inspect the actual final Word pages.

curve_diagnostics_preserve_matched_units.statement: Use distinct matched-summary and aligned local trajectory/state roles when the saved evidence supports them. Keep case selection, denominators, member order and units; distinguish expert dispersion, predictive coverage, confidence and threshold events. Numeric coordinates remain truthful during layout repair.

project_rich_scientific_figures.statement: 取消简单柱线、稀疏独立散点和均值排名的默认输出，优先约束诊断、窗口分配、条件分布、时空图谱和多指标联动；复杂度必须来自真实数据，保持图型互补与最终尺寸可读性。

version_history.summary: 补齐Project经验维护和回归；兼容有序公式清单；修复Word模板和纯公式表格转换；加入原生Office流程与编辑检查；升级图型规则、模板、生成器和来源校验。
